sonnet.problem: Numbers 23:15 repeats Balaam's line from 23:3 ('Stay here by your burnt offering while I...'). That line was already told and asked about in stop 1 (cards 9-10). This card asks about it a second time.
sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage.

sonnet.problem: Balaam's 'whatever the LORD says, I must do' (23:26) repeats his earlier 'I must speak only the word that God puts in my mouth' (22:38). 22:38 was already asked in stop 1 card 4, and 23:12 was asked again in stop 1 card 20. This is a third question on the same repeated line.
sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage.

sonnet.problem: Numbers 23:30 repeats the pattern of 23:2 (Balak builds the seven altars as instructed and offers a bull and a ram on each). That pattern was already asked about in stop 1 card 8. This card asks the same fact again.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: Balaam's reply in 23:12 ('Should I not speak exactly what the LORD puts in my mouth?') repeats his earlier line in 22:38, which was already asked in stop 1 card 4. This card tests the same repeated fact again.
sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage.

sonnet.problem: The same punchline shape, 'Friend, that's [comparison]...', appears on stop 1 cards 3, 7 and 19. It repeats the shape within one lesson.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
